components.scope: component row, engine only: the remainder of AMR-02.2. The engine's owner issues one exact single-use network grant for an admitted research run under the plan's mode: a task-authorized plan takes the plan confirmation recorded by a session parent whose preview is the plan's digest, and an ask plan also takes the person's approval of the exact packet digest; the budget owner checks the request without spending (offline, cancellation, R10 visit and disclosed-query classification, a dry-run reservation, the packet interval and a live plan); one grant per call; the existing issuer derives the child, which names the packet as its only effect and expires with the packet or the parent; the governing policy evaluates the exact grant against the packet's own destination; parent, child and the caller's permission event commit atomically, and a refusal commits and spends nothing. The start of a research effect requires its policy network scope to name the packet's destination. Tested through the real coordinator and the real owners with a synthetic native result and an in-memory payload store; no host, worker, provider, model or network takes part, and Decision 0084 still forbids host or provider activation

mutation_checks: run on the exact source tree before it was committed, with private tooling that applies one exact replacement, runs the engine's filtered library tests (research_admission_tests) and restores the file; the specification and results are attached to the batch24-source stage. One run of 19 single mutations, all caught: the owner's terminal cause clause and the start's destination binding; the issuance mode match (any mode, and the plan confirmation under any mode), the approved preview, the policy digest, the parent's session, task and plan binding, one grant per call, the policy allow, the policy destination, the parent expiry bound, the effect details and the shared call validation; and in the budget check the packet interval, the R10 and disclosed-query classification, the dry-run reservation and the live plan. The tree was verified identical afterwards
